design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — installation_contract_servicing, task 0 (written as decisions were made; session was cut off twice by account limits, resumed from disk each time).

STEP 0 — draw and scope. draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 5]}; --tasks 2 printed task 1 = {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 4, 6]}. Snapshot: nothing occupied before this task. Claimed here: install_ext_reschedule_fee (agent, 5 factors) and install_ext_final_payment (user, root, 5 factors); tools post_reschedule_fee_05a0220d and pay_final_balance_37ea441b. Reserved headroom for task 1 (4 problems): the trip charge, the change order administration fee, the permit handling fee and the progress payment on a started job — none of them touched here. Subject choice: credit lines (install_credit_applied), signing, cancellation and change-order billing carry caller_statement gates keyed to the contract uuid, which no persona line can bind, so every problem of this difficulty is a fee line (install_fee_charged, all governing policies policy_scope) or a payment (install_payment_received, gate payable_status).
Design thesis: surface goal 'pay off what's left on my finished kitchen installation by bank card' -> the final settlement payment rule says it is worked out only after every customer reschedule recorded on the contract carries the reschedule fee line owed for it -> the records show a completed reschedule registered 15 hours before the window with no fee line -> the agent posts the reschedule fee (5-factor computation) -> then computes the final settlement payment (5-factor computation) on the world with that line -> the customer authorises the bank card charge herself. Depth: 1 hop of prerequisite + 2 multi-factor computations; breadth: install ledger (13 lines), install requests, card ledger (cross-difficulty), linked special order (cross-difficulty).

WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer never mentions the reschedule; the fee is owed by the records (state_due) and only the final-payment rule's prerequisite sentence reveals that it must be posted first. Both numbers require reading several documents: an agent with only the computation documents computes 150.00 and 8,895.00/8,996.25. No tool selection difficulty: each problem has exactly one tool.

FACTOR CARD — install_ext_reschedule_fee (baseline: the program's reschedule fee 150.00; baseline_result 150.00; expected 101.25):
- reschedule_notice (method): notice = calendar days from request registration 2026-09-13 to original installation date 2026-09-14 = 1 -> starting amount 150 x 1.5 = 225.00 (tiers: 0 days fee + trip charge; 1 day x next-day multiple; otherwise fee). Baseline figure 67.50.
- cardholder_courtesy (parameter, cross-difficulty card, multi-source): active Preferred card 2b1087f2... AND no late fee less than 12 whole months before today -> 0.75 (Premier 0.5, otherwise 1). Near-miss: late fee 4a28b722... on 2025-08-13 is 13 whole months old and excluded by the window. Baseline figure 135.00.
- job_history (parameter, multi-source): installer no-show at the 2026-05-11 measure visit (a3286298...) and no customer-absent/site-not-ready visit -> goodwill 0.5. Baseline figure 202.50.
- job_size (parameter): billed contract price 16,850.00 >= 15,000 floor -> 1.5. Baseline figure 67.50.
- move_distance (parameter): 2026-09-14 -> 2026-09-21 = 7 days <= same-week days 7 -> 0.8 (boundary near-miss: an 8-day move would take 1). Baseline figure 126.56.
FACTOR CARD — install_ext_final_payment (baseline: open balance; baseline_result 8,996.25; expected 6,863.20):
- punch_list_holdback (parameter): punch_list_open true, 5 days since completion <= 14 resolution days -> full share, 1,685.00. Baseline 8,548.20.
- project_bundle (method, cross-difficulty special, multi-source): linked special order a96a5c76... completed AND order total 11,940.00 >= 10,000 -> 2 percent = 238.80 (below floor: flat 100.00). Baseline 7,102.00.
- settlement_timing (parameter): 5 days since completion <= 5 due days (inclusive boundary; near-miss: one more day gives rate 0) -> -0.5 percent of 16,850.00 = -84.25. Baseline 6,947.45.
- change_order_fee_forgiveness (parameter): CO-1 420.00 = 2.49 percent < 5 AND 50.00 administration fee charged -> 50.00 forgiven. Baseline 6,913.20.
- materials_lateness (parameter, cross-difficulty special, multi-source): promised 2026-07-22, ready 2026-07-31 = 9 days, <= 14 AND <= Semi-Custom Cabinetry vendor delay threshold 21 -> 75.00. Baseline 6,938.20.
No factor reads a stamp: punch_list_open is the walkthrough record itself; every tier rests on ledger lines, dates or the other product's rows.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Reschedule fee write (install_fee_charged): governing base policies install_agg_same_address, install_cancellation_fees, install_scheduling, install_visits_and_delays, install_change_orders, install_permits_and_haul_away — none has an eligibility gate applying to install_fee_charged, so all are policy_scope. The base decision that a fee is owed is install_scheduling's free test: 15 hours' notice < 72 free-notice hours, count before the request 0 < 3 -> not free -> fee owed. overwrite: the base sentence 'otherwise one install_fee_charged row with fee_type reschedule_fee posts, referencing the reschedule request.' is replaced by the extended amount sentence (base priced it at reschedule_fee_usd 150.00; extended gives 101.25 here). Final payment write (install_payment_received): install_payments.payable_status — status completed is in the allowed set (evidence install_contracts.41bfb673....status). overwrites: install_payments' 'remaining balance ... subject to the punch-list holdback' and install_completion_and_closure's 'customer may withhold up to' clause, both replaced by the extended amount and holdback sentences. No time gate applies to either write (temporal_feasibility []). Payment tender is bank_card, so no card/trade trigger fires (no cross-category write).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target contract 41bfb673... (IC-2214-381506). Reschedule fee keyed to request a3c21706... (the only reschedule request; the other request 3f2619c8... is the change order). Final payment: all 13 install_charges lines of the contract enter the open balance; the measure fee credit e1602bc0... settles the measure fee 2a1b97d4...; the check payment 663f373f... settled the two permit lines; the special order's own payments live on the special order and never enter this contract's balance.

SEED. Rows: customer, Preferred card + 4 card lines (purchase, statement, the old late fee, payment), the kitchen contract, 13 contract lines, 2 requests, the linked cabinetry special order. Removing the measure-visit no-show changes job_history (share 1 -> 202.50); removing the old late fee does not change the tier (it is the near-miss) but removing the 12-month window would; removing the special order zeroes both special allowances. balance_due 8,895.00 equals the ledger. Automatic clauses checked: no delay credit is owed (start 2026-09-21 is 7 days after the original date, below the 14-day threshold, and the move was the customer's); no trip charge (no customer-side failed visit); no no-show credit (the missed visit was a measure); contract does not close (balance owed). Special order: placed while the kitchen contract was contracted (pro_measure_required), 9 days late (< 21 threshold: no special delay remedy), balance 0.00. Card: first late fee 32.00 the day after the 2025-08-12 due date with no payment; paid 444.60 on 2025-08-20, balance 0.00.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root install_ext_final_payment; edge -> install_ext_reschedule_fee, kind value_input, gate fee_total, form state. Prerequisite sentence (in the final-payment rule): 'The final settlement payment is worked out only after every customer reschedule recorded on the contract carries the reschedule fee line owed for it.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; waits on a record-visible state (a reschedule fee line referencing each owed reschedule); no tool, id or code token; scope 'every customer reschedule ... owed' matches the condition (free reschedules owe nothing). Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: the reschedule-fee policy's tool is the only writer of fee_type reschedule_fee. Derivation: sentence + install_requests (completed reschedule, 15 hours' notice) + install_charges (no reschedule fee line) + the reschedule-fee rule ('posts as one reschedule fee line ... referencing the reschedule request') -> post the reschedule fee. Unresolved at frozen_time: no install_charges row with fee_type reschedule_fee. Topological order: reschedule fee (step 9) then final payment (step 11). Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 9 -> 6,761.95 instead of 6,863.20. user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate none. The customer's own write is the final payment (owner=user): she authorises a charge to her own bank card, completed on the spot.

PERSONA. Rosalind Achterberg, organised pharmacist; volunteers only the goal; phone/ZIP/DOB/email/contract number/address/punch-list detail/other accounts only when asked; passive reactions: agrees when told a charge must be put on first, runs the payment tool for exactly the amount given, closes after the confirmation. No figure of her own, no extra asks.

STANDARD SOLUTION (12 actions): find_customers(phone) -> verify(ZIP, DOB) -> find_install_contracts -> find_install_charges -> find_install_requests -> find_card_accounts -> find_card_transactions -> find_special_orders(linked) -> unlock/call post_reschedule_fee_05a0220d(contract, request a3c21706..., 101.25) -> unlock_user/call_user pay_final_balance_37ea441b(contract, 6863.20).

VERIFICATION RUN (handling-time recompute via check_compute internals, executed): reschedule fee bindings notice_days=1, notice_start_amount=225.0, cardholder_share=0.75, job_history_share=0.5, job_size_share=1.5, move_days=7, move_distance_share=0.8, result=101.25; factor baselines 67.5/135.0/202.5/67.5/126.56, all-baseline 150.0. Final payment: open_balance=8996.25, holdback_amount=1685.0, bundle_allowance=238.8, settlement_adjustment=-84.25, fee_forgiveness=50.0, lateness_allowance=75.0, result=6863.2; factor baselines 8548.2/7102.0/6947.45/6913.2/6938.2, all-baseline 8996.25; skipping the reschedule fee -> 6761.95.
Gates run: check_task_tools OK, check_extended --task 0 OK, replay_tasks --task 0 OK (after replacing empty id strings with null and dropping 4 unread special_order_events rows as closure noise), check_solvability --task 0 OK, check_compute --task 0 OK, check_grounding --task 0 OK, check_cross_fire --task 0 OK. Revision log: (1) replay flagged empty-string foreign keys as dangling -> root cause: empty ids written as '' -> changed seed and tools to null -> replay OK. (2) closure mismatch (4 special_order_events never read) -> removed them; no computation read them.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Reading only the published rules and the find_* returns: the contract is completed (payable), the reschedule request has 1 day's notice and no fee line, so the fee is posted first at 150 x 1.5 x 0.75 x 0.5 x 1.5 x 0.8 = 101.25; then the final settlement payment = 8,996.25 - 1,685.00 - 238.80 - 50.00 - 75.00 - 84.25 = 6,863.20, paid by the customer. Agrees with gold.
user_scenario: You are Rosalind Achterberg, a hospital pharmacist in Minneapolis, calling Ridgeline Customer Care on a weekday afternoon between shifts. Ridgeline's crew finished installing your new kitchen cabinets and countertop last week, and you want to settle up what you still owe on that installation today, paying it yourself with your own bank card over the phone. You open briefly and warmly, something like: "Hi, my kitchen installation is finished and I'd like to pay off what's left on it today with my bank card." You speak in short, organised sentences and you like to be told the figure before anything is charged. You do not remember the exact balance and you have no figure of your own in mind; you rely on Ridgeline to tell you the correct amount under its rules and you will pay exactly that. When the agent asks how to find you, you give your phone number, 6125550342. When asked to confirm your identity you give your billing ZIP code, 55410, and your date of birth, 1979-11-02; if a further detail is asked for, your email is rosalind.achterberg@fastmail.com. Only if asked for the contract you give the number on your paperwork, IC-2214-381506, and the job address, 4417 Upton Avenue South, Minneapolis, MN 55410. Only if the agent asks whether anything is still unfinished, you say one pantry door does not close flush and the installer noted it at the walkthrough and is coming back for it. Only if asked about other Ridgeline accounts, you say you have a Ridgeline credit card you mostly use for small store purchases, and that your cabinets were ordered through Ridgeline as a special order that you already paid off. If the agent explains that a charge has to be put on the contract before the final amount can be worked out, you pause, say that is fair if that is how it works, and tell them to go ahead. When the agent tells you the amount and hands the payment over to you, you complete it yourself for exactly the amount the agent gave you and then read back the confirmation you receive if asked. If the agent asks which card, it is your own bank debit card. You do not ask for anything else. Once you have the payment confirmation, you thank the agent and end the call.
